integrity: The full local-depolarization density matrix and its partial-transpose two-dimensional blocks are reconstructed analytically. Every symmetric-noise rank-switch formula follows from an exact discrete quadratic difference. Independent numerical matrix calculations are checks, not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact rank optimization is exclusively over pure coherent inputs with equal amplitudes on a support of size k. No global optimality over nonuniform Schmidt spectra, universal entanglement-annihilation novelty, or all-PPT separability equivalence is claimed.
title: Exact Schmidt-support rank ladder under independent qudit depolarization
